performance|src/processing.worker.ts|112.why_it_matters: Applying even one staged correction now recomputes every row and output field before the corrected view appears. For the supported 10,000-row, 20-column workflow, correction latency therefore grows with the entire dataset rather than the number of touched rows, losing the prior incremental path and putting the documented 200 ms single-row target at risk. Evaluate the touched rows as one candidate batch, then publish the merged run only after all validation succeeds.
